name: BEYOND the HARBOR: r
source:
Two years ago, Oliver Blanche disappeared.

A young aspiring detective catches wind of the case, and decides that if nobody else was going to solve this, he would. Little did he know, that he was involving himself with something much bigger.

[From [url=https://harmoyena.itch.io/beyond-the-harbor]Itch.io[/url]]

A remake of the discontinued BEYOND the HARBOR.
translation:
两年前，奥利弗·布兰奇失踪了。

一位立志成为侦探的年轻人听说了这起案件，决定既然没有别人来查明真相，就由自己来。他却不知道，自己正卷入一件远比想象中庞大的事情。

[摘自[url=https://harmoyena.itch.io/beyond-the-harbor]Itch.io[/url]]

本作是已停止开发的《BEYOND the HARBOR》的重制版。
